Title: Diagnosis of test `org.apache.commons.math3.fraction.FractionTest.testMath835()`
Details: The test `org.apache.commons.math3.fraction.FractionTest.testMath835()` checks whether the `percentageValue` method of the `Fraction` class calculates the fraction percentage correctly as the numerator divided by the denominator multiplied by 100. The test seems to compare the percentage value calculated manually with the one obtained from the `percentageValue` method. The failure in this test indicates that the calculated percentage values are not matching as expected.

By analyzing the code, it is observed that the `percentageValue` method in the `Fraction` class calculates the percentage by multiplying the fraction by 100. The constructor of the `Fraction` class performs necessary validations and reductions of the numerator and denominator.

One possible reason for the failure could be related to the arithmetic involved in calculating the percentage manually versus the calculation done in the `percentageValue` method. 

Further investigation is required to pinpoint the exact cause of the discrepancy between the manually calculated percentage and the one obtained from the `percentageValue` method.
